summary: Axe Compute Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering, increasing the aggregate offer amount to $100 million of common stock under a sales agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. The filing updates the public float (approximately $90 million) to remove sales volume limits under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3. No share price per share or fixed price is set; sales occur at market prices. The filing is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, or structural changes are involved. Watch for market conditions affecting ATM drawdowns; no risk-arb angle.
